title: Private Key West Fishing & Sandbar or Snorkel Charter
includes: Lily Pad is included if you chose the sandbar activity
All fishing equipment & bait are included.
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Infants are required to sit on an adult’s lap
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
1 Traveler is equivalent to reserving the entire boat. (Up to 6 Guests)

Explore the vibrant waters of Key West on a fully custom private charter designed for up to 6 guests. Enjoy family-friendly bottom fishing, where all bait and equipment are provided, ensuring a fun-filled fishing experience. We will be targeting grouper, barracuda, yellowtail snapper, mangrove snapper, sharks & much more. 

After reeling in your catch, choose between relaxing at a stunning sandbar or go on a reef snorkeling adventure in crystal-clear waters with our expert captain guiding you to the best spots. Dive into this unforgettable adventure that caters to families and ocean lovers alike, complete with all necessary gear for both activities.

Highlights
- Private 4-hour charter for up to 6 guests
- Family-friendly bottom fishing with included bait and equipment
- Choose between a beautiful sandbar experience with lily pad float or snorkeling
- All snorkeling gear provided for your convenience
